# SafeTrack Pro Global

> SafeTrack Pro Global (https://www.safetrackproglobal.com) is AI-powered HSE / EHS software: incident and near-miss reporting, permit to work, daily AI toolbox talks, anonymous worker reporting (Workplace Voice), an AI HSE document generator, document control, risk assessment, AI camera PPE monitoring, environmental monitoring and compliance management.

Also written as: SafeTrack Pro, SafeTrackPro, Safe Track Pro.

Not to be confused with: SafeStart's "SafeTrack" coaching program, MaxAccel's "SafeTrack" rail compliance software, Brady's "SafeTrak" inspection app, or GPS tracking apps named SafeTrack. Those are unrelated products from other companies.

## Main features

- [Incident reporting](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/incident-reporting-software): report incidents and near misses from any device, investigate with fishbone and 5-Whys, assign and track corrective actions (CAPA).
- [AI toolbox talk generator](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/toolbox-talk-generator): a new talk every day built from the company's own incidents, near misses, open actions, permits and local weather, or from any typed topic; delivery sign-off and history.
- [Anonymous safety reporting - Workplace Voice](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/anonymous-safety-reporting): workers report by QR code or website, without logging in, by voice, photo, video or text in 11 languages; anonymous, protected or named; routed per project; tracking codes and Safety Impact rewards. Public portal: https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/voice
- [Permit to work](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/permit-to-work-software): create, approve and close permits with risk assessments and audit trails.
- [AI HSE document generator](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/ai-hse-document-generator): SOPs, JHAs, risk assessments, checklists and reports with company branding; drafts should be reviewed by a qualified person.
- [Document control](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/document-control-software): review, sign, stamp and version safety documents.
- [AI risk assessment](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/ai-risk-assessment-software)
- [AI camera monitoring](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/ai-camera-monitoring): PPE and hazard detection on existing cameras.
- [Environmental monitoring](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/environmental-monitoring-software): air quality, weather and ESG reporting.
- [Compliance management](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/compliance-management-software), [HSE dashboards](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/hse-dashboard-software), [HSE analytics](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/hse-analytics-software), [HSE project management](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/hse-project-management-software), [workforce and training](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/workforce-management-software).
- [CSP practice exam](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/csp-practice-exam): a CSP-style practice test (100 scenario questions, 4 hours, instant explanations). It is NOT the official CSP exam, is not affiliated with or endorsed by BCSP, and does not award the CSP credential or CEUs. Passing gives a certificate of completion that can be verified online.

## Free resources (no account)

- [Free safety documents](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/free-safety-documents): editable risk assessments, JSAs, permits, method statements and plans by industry, downloadable as PDF.
- [Free CSP practice test](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/csp-practice-exam/free-test): 10 questions with explanations (practice only).

## Industries

[Construction](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/construction), [oil and gas](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/oil-and-gas), [mining](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/mining), [manufacturing](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/manufacturing), [chemical](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/chemical), [maritime](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/maritime), [aviation](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/aviation), [healthcare](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/healthcare), [education](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/industries/education).

## Standards

Templates, checklists and tracking aligned with [OSHA](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/compliance/osha), [ISO 45001](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/compliance/iso-45001), [ISO 14001](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/compliance/iso-14001) and [HIPAA](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/compliance/hipaa). Using the software supports compliance work; it does not certify an organisation.

## Security

Role-based access, company data isolation, audit trails and attack monitoring. Security practices are aligned with ISO 27001 and SOC 2; see the [Trust page](https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/trust).

## Plans

A free plan is available. Current prices by country: https://www.safetrackproglobal.com/pricing

## Languages

English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese and German (switch inside the app).
